where.if: and (t.name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.city ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

if.test: status != null and status != '' and status.toLowerCase() != 'all'

where.if: and t.trial_end_at between current_timestamp and current_timestamp + interval '7 days'

mapper.select:
select t.id, t.name, t.city, t.trial_start_at::date as trialStartAt, t.trial_end_at::date as trialEndAt, t.status, coalesce(tenant_wechat.wechat_id, default_wechat.wechat_id) as supportWechatId, coalesce(f.issued_cards, 0) as issuedCards, coalesce(f.deductions, 0) as deductions, coalesce(f.warning_count, 0) as warningCount, coalesce(f.monthly_sales_yuan, 0) as monthlySalesYuan from tenant t left join support_wechat tenant_wechat on tenant_wechat.tenant_id = t.id left join support_wechat default_wechat on default_wechat.tenant_id is null left join lateral ( select (select count(*) from member_card mc where mc.tenant_id = t.id) as issued_cards, (select count(*) from deduction_record dr where dr.tenant_id = t.id) as deductions, (select count(*) from member_card mc left join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id where mc.tenant_id = t.id and ( mc.base_status = 'suspended' or mc.valid_until < current_date or (mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count = 0) or (mc.valid_until between current_date and current_date + 7) or (mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count <= coalesce(ct.low_balance_threshold, 0)) )) as warning_count, (select coalesce(sum(os.sale_amount_yuan), 0) from offline_sale_record os where os.tenant_id = t.id and os.sale_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date) as monthly_sales_yuan ) f on true
order by t.trial_end_at asc, t.id asc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}

select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where status = 'trialing') as trialing, count(*) filter (where status = 'expiring') as expiring, count(*) filter (where status = 'frozen') as frozen, count(*) filter (where status = 'extended') as extended from tenant

select t.id, t.name, t.city, t.status, t.trial_start_at::date as trial_start_at, t.trial_end_at::date as trial_end_at, t.freeze_reason, coalesce(tenant_wechat.wechat_id, default_wechat.wechat_id) as support_wechat_id, st.name as store_name, st.business_categories::text as business_categories, st.service_tags::text as service_tags, st.address, st.contact_phone, st.business_hours::text as business_hours, coalesce(f.issued_cards, 0) as issued_cards, coalesce(f.checkins, 0) as checkins, coalesce(f.deductions, 0) as deductions, coalesce(f.warning_count, 0) as warning_count, coalesce(f.low_balance_count, 0) as low_balance_count, coalesce(f.expiring_count, 0) as expiring_count, coalesce(f.monthly_sales_yuan, 0) as monthly_sales_yuan, f.last_activity_at from tenant t left join store st on st.tenant_id = t.id left join support_wechat tenant_wechat on tenant_wechat.tenant_id = t.id left join support_wechat default_wechat on default_wechat.tenant_id is null left join lateral ( select (select count(*) from member_card mc where mc.tenant_id = t.id) as issued_cards, (select count(*) from attendance_confirm ar where ar.tenant_id = t.id) as checkins, (select count(*) from deduction_record dr where dr.tenant_id = t.id) as deductions, (select count(*) from member_card mc left join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id where mc.tenant_id = t.id and ( mc.base_status = 'suspended' or mc.valid_until < current_date or (mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count = 0) or (mc.valid_until between current_date and current_date + 7) or (mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count <= coalesce(ct.low_balance_threshold, 0)) )) as warning_count, (select count(*) from member_card mc join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id where mc.tenant_id = t.id and mc.base_status = 'active' and mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count > 0 and mc.remain_count <= coalesce(ct.low_balance_threshold, 0) and mc.valid_until >= current_date) as low_balance_count, (select count(*) from member_card mc where mc.tenant_id = t.id and mc.base_status = 'active' and mc.valid_until between current_date and current_date + 7) as expiring_count, (select coalesce(sum(os.sale_amount_yuan), 0) from offline_sale_record os where os.tenant_id = t.id and os.sale_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date) as monthly_sales_yuan, greatest( (select max(os.created_at) from offline_sale_record os where os.tenant_id = t.id), (select max(ar.confirmed_at) from attendance_confirm ar where ar.tenant_id = t.id), (select max(dr.deducted_at) from deduction_record dr where dr.tenant_id = t.id) ) as last_activity_at ) f on true where t.id = #{tenantId}

select id, name, city, status, trial_start_at as trialStartAt, trial_end_at as trialEndAt, freeze_reason as freezeReason, frozen_at as frozenAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from tenant where status != 'frozen' and trial_end_at < current_timestamp order by trial_end_at asc, id asc
mapper.update: update tenant set status = 'frozen', freeze_reason = #{reason}, frozen_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{tenantId} and status != 'frozen' and trial_end_at < current_timestamp
